Q974.reason: Schober's test measures the increase in distance between two skin marks during lumbar flexion, so it quantifies lumbar flexion; the other options are false (back pain is very common, ankylosing spondylitis causes stiffness, pregnancy increases lordosis).

Q975.reason: Bicarbonate raises extracellular pH and buffering capacity, which speeds the efflux of hydrogen ions from working muscle and delays fatigue.

Q976.reason: The customer completed larceny of the gun and made an overt, threatening demand for money that failed, so the crime is attempted robbery; assault fails because the owner knew the gun was unloaded and so had no reasonable apprehension, and attempted larceny is wrong because the gun was actually taken.
